dataInfo.description: This JSON file contains detailed information about various proteins, including their names, aliases, binding types, descriptions, sequences, and simulation statuses. The data is structured in a way that allows for easy access to each protein's attributes using their unique identifiers (UIDs) as keys.
dataInfo.uniprot_domain_start: N-terminal UniProt residue number of the simulated domain construct (inclusive). Present for reference/representative systems with verified length match to sequence.
dataInfo.uniprot_domain_end: C-terminal UniProt residue number of the simulated domain construct (inclusive).
dataInfo.uniprot_numbering_note: How to convert local simulation residue indices to UniProt numbering.

metadata.description: Protein information database for pseudokinase RMSF analysis
metadata.notes: UniProt IDs starting with 'NA_' are custom identifiers for proteins without standard UniProt entries | Added pseudokinase_stats summarizing binding_lig_mg groups, /pseudoKin completion, non-pseudokinase sims (*), and <200 ns runs.

pseudokinase_stats.description: Summary of the "pseudokinase" study list versus simulations under /pseudoKin. UniProt IDs prefixed with * are present in /pseudoKin but are NOT members of the "pseudokinase" list (e.g. ground-truth active kinases). Simulation length is the last time_ns from ligand/pocket distance analysis CSVs.
notes: Matching is case-insensitive between UniProt IDs and /pseudoKin/{uid} directories.
Duration source preference: analysis/ligand_pocket_distance.csv, then consensus/reference pocket distance CSVs.
Entries marked *{uniprot} are simulations that are not members of the "pseudokinase" list.
Directories reporter/ and supervisor/ under /pseudoKin were ignored as non-simulation folders.
Removed RYK, ROP2, and ROP5Bi because they contained only md.tpr and no .xtc trajectory.
